name: Downtown Huntington Beach Center
description: Downtown Huntington Beach Center is a vibrant lifestyle destination located steps from the iconic Huntington Beach Pier along Pacific Coast Highway. This open-air shopping and dining district captures the quintessential California beach lifestyle with a mix of local boutiques, surf shops, restaurants, and entertainment venues. The center serves as the heart of the downtown Huntington Beach community, attracting both locals and tourists seeking the authentic SoCal beach town experience.
summary: A beachfront lifestyle center in the heart of downtown Huntington Beach offering shopping, dining, and entertainment with authentic California surf culture.
